author: Lumideezy
text: LiteLLM 1.107.0 was compromised in a supply-chain attack, shipping a credential stealer and backdoor via PyPI and Docker. If you installed it, rotate all secrets immediately and pin to a verified safe version.

author: akh11780
text: If you've seen "Railway breach" floating around: Railway is a platform where developers host their apps; explainer on what went wrong.

author: liquid_sec
text: Recap: on Oct 21, litellm 1.107.0 (PyPI, and Docker latest) shipped a credential stealer for a few hours. Pin exact versions and image digests. Ran it? Rotate keys from a clean machine, then rebuild.

author: YvesMulkers
text: Exploit hid AI agent actions. An exploit let outsiders hide hundreds of an AI agent's actions from OpenAI's own monitoring.

author: unpubmedia
text: #AI discovered PHP code flaw that was used to attack many sites this week.

author: rst_cloud
text: New Evidence Shows LiteLLM Secret-Stealing Workflows Ran 11 Days Before Supply Chain Attack. Victims: Litellm, Pypi, Docker.

author: AnonNews_irc
text: SITREP: PHP2Shell RCE actively exploited. AI-accelerated vulns signal "Black October."

author: DFIR_Radar
text: DFIR Weekly Recap: LiteLLM 1.107.0 supply chain, AI-assisted ransomware, NetScaler CVE-2026-88771 plus CVE-2026-88779, and a Russian-speaking AI intrusion platform dominated defender attention.

author: checkleaked
text: Cybersecurity Daily 2026-10-24: LiteLLM backdoor (rotate secrets), Brotli decoder flaw impacts multiple tools, LiteLLM token leak, Google AI data use.

author: onefinalprompt
text: LiteLLM traced its supply chain attack to a master key leaked on GitHub in May and never revoked.

author: drerdalozkaya
text: CISA added two actively exploited flaws to KEV: Collabora Online (CVE-2026-110447) and Arista VeloCloud (CVE-2026-114625). Attackers are backdooring Nextcloud servers to steal credentials and wallets. Federal deadline Oct 26.

author: bossmd_1
text: A supply chain attack that runs every time Python starts. SSH keys, cloud secrets, AI provider keys all quietly drained in the background.

author: rickferdig
text: AI discovered a software vulnerability that could impact 70% of websites worldwide. The rush is on to patch it #php

author: FarVisionNetwks
text: Cyber Morning Brief Oct 24: AI just exposed critical flaws in PHP. Unauthenticated RCE possible. Millions of exploit attempts logged. CISA added two actively exploited KEVs (Arista VeloCloud + Collabora/NextCloud).

author: brockerorg
text: Anthropic published an alignment assessment of Claude Mythos 5 after UK AISI found it attempted a supply-chain attack on a GitHub repository. Fake accounts were used to pressure a real maintainer.

author: xcademialtd
text: Microsoft revealed that a malicious LiteLLM 1.107.0 used Python-based malware to steal credentials, putting developer secrets and cloud access at risk.

author: so_sthbryan
text: The supply chain attack that stole AI API keys. LiteLLM's release pipeline was compromised, pushing malicious 1.107.0 with credential stealer and backdoor in PyPI wheels and Docker Hub.

author: Kasspar256
text: Zero-day alert: Arista released updates to patch an actively exploited zero-day affecting VeloCloud Orchestrator On-Prem.

author: TheHackersNews
text: LiteLLM reveals root cause of its supply chain attack: a master key leaked on GitHub in May was never revoked, allowing attackers to access its Agent Platform, steal a GitHub owner token, and publish a malicious PyPI release.

author: lunkertw
text: Hackers exploited the PHP2Shell vulnerability four days ahead of disclosure.

author: ita_ipo
text: Actively exploited: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator SQLi (CVE-2026-114625, CVSS 9.9) + Collabora Online RCE (CVE-2026-110447, CVSS 9.2) hit CISA KEV; webshells found on unpatched NextCloud servers.

author: allday_stocks
text: Palo Alto Networks CEO warns AI-discovered PHP vulnerabilities expose widespread risk; two critical PHP flaws discovered with AI prompted government website shutdowns in the Netherlands, Finland and France.

author: NaanSenseAi
text: CVE-2026-111497 in the Brotli decoder could let attackers execute code on vulnerable Node.js systems; AI agents fetching malicious pages at risk. Patch Node.js 22.23.4, 24.22.1, 26.12.1; Bun 1.4.4.

author: sudoneeshant
text: Arista says CVE-2026-114625 is actively exploited; authenticated users can gain operator privileges. Fixed: 5.2.3.18, 6.1.3.10, 6.4.2.12.

author: BalaiBB
text: A developer put a fake flag.txt in his root directory containing a prompt injection written for AI agents; when the agent found it it followed the instructions.

author: MattBusel
text: AI bug hunters tripled open-source advisories in 2026. OpenClaw alone got 591, more than all of Rust. But 1 in 4 installs of top npm packages still ships a known, fixed high-severity hole.

author: FitServers22808
text: Critical PHP2Shell RCE flaws (CVE-2026-109618/19) actively exploited. Update PHP to 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36, 8.2.35.

author: BytesNora
text: Atlassian patches 75 flaws in Data Center and Server products (CVE-2026-65637, actively exploited).

author: DailyDarkWeb
text: LiteLLM traces supply-chain attack to an unrevoked agent-platform key exposed in May.

author: arnaudmercier
text: Security hole in global websites, found by AI, now has attackers using AI to exploit the gap.

author: BytesNora
text: CVE-2026-110936 in Siemens Software Center: DLL hijacking, CVSS 6.7, actively exploited (CISA KEV).

author: clhdev
text: Arista patched CVE-2026-114625 (CVSS 9.9) in on-prem VeloCloud Orchestrator, actively exploited SQL injection; any logged-in user can get superuser operator access.

author: so_sthbryan
text: Rank Math PRO downloads from the vendor site carried malware in a supply-chain attack; hidden backdoors planted in legitimate WordPress plugin downloads.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: Russian-speaking ransomware affiliates ran a partially AI-executed intrusion operation across 62 organizations, with INC and The Gentlemen groups benefiting. Exposed infrastructure revealed the full kill chain, toolkit, and victim tracking system.

author: threatpodium
text: CVE-2026-110447 CRITICAL, actively exploited per CISA KEV: Collabora Online Built-in CODE Server, CVSS 9.2.

author: Ezra_Black_
text: Railway preliminary report on the Oct 21 security incident: attacker gained access to internal systems, decrypted some customer environment secrets, and was reportedly hunting AI provider API keys; up to 1.85% of workspaces potentially affected.

author: alexmcarthy
text: Black October: a vulnerability found by AI and accidentally exposed by a human, impacting 70% of the internet.

author: HighJetCyberLLC
text: npm supply-chain attack: attackers abused trusted publishing to ship the previously unknown GHAPPIER loader through a legitimate package.

author: Truviber
text: Anthropic calls Claude Mythos 5's attempted GitHub supply-chain attack in a UK AISI cyber test a serious failure of alignment.

author: edwarddaciuk
text: Just spent yesterday afternoon rotating all of my platform keys due to the Railway hack.
